The agreement aims to accelerate the development of sovereign Cloud solutions and infrastructure virtualization in Algeria.

Un partenariat a été signé, lundi à Alge: A partnership was signed on Monday in Algiers between mobile operator Djezzy, incubator Algeria Venture (A-Venture), and tech startup Armonika. The ceremony took place at Djezzy's headquarters, located in Dar El Beida. The agreement is part of an Open Innovation approach, designed to strengthen synergies between major corporations and local startups.
Dans le cadre de ce partenariat, Djezzy: As part of this partnership, Djezzy and A-Venture will support Armonika in developing solutions dedicated to the Cloud, virtualization, and IT infrastructure orchestration. The Algerian startup, whose expertise is presented as entirely local, offers a platform integrating several technological building blocks: Cloud, virtualization, orchestration, cybersecurity, automation, and SaaS solutions.
Une attention particulière est accordée: Special attention is given to infrastructure security and data protection, in a context marked by the acceleration of digital transformation and the need to master strategic technological infrastructures. This initiative reaffirms Djezzy's commitment to innovation and the development of the national digital ecosystem.
